product_metadata.title: Wilton Decorator Preferred Aluminum Round Cake Pan, 12-inch x 3-inch
features: READY SET, BAKE: Bake and decorate a tall cake with ease using this cake pan. Well-loved by home bakers and professionals alike for its durability, even heating and baking, this aluminum pan was designed to help you make tall, clean layer cakes
PERFORMANCE: The anodized aluminum construction of the Wilton cake pan resists rust and ensures even heating for uniform baking for years to come

CONVENIENT: The 3-inch high walls help prevent domes from forming (layers easier to stack). The extra wide rims make the cake pan easier to handle when filled with heavy batters and offer added support and stability when moving your cake in and out of the oven

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Hand wash cake pan before first and after each use; for longevity do not place in dishwasher and avoid using metal utensils; some staining and scratching may occur, but will not affect the performance of the bakeware
INCLUDES: 1 cake pan dimensions: 12 x 3 in. (30.4 x 7.62 cm)
description: Get the cake pan that's the go-to for professional bakers with this 3 x 12 inch round cake pan for years to come. Made with premium aluminum for even heating, the sides are deeper, so you get a higher cake that's perfect for layering and decorating. Use it for pound cake or when you need a reliable cheesecake pan. Whether you love to bake once a week or once a month, Wilton has the bakeware to help you make the most out of your favorite foods. Your holiday treats will be easy to make with this 12 in cake pan. Since 1929, Wilton has been helping home bakers and cake decorators all over the world create sweet treats and beautiful desserts by giving them the baking tools to make it fun and easy. So, go ahead, get your bake on with Wilton, and make the kitchen your happy place.

This pan is designed for the serious cake baker and decorator. If you're ready to tackle professional-quality, tiered wedding cakes and other large special occasion cakes, this pan's for you. With 3-inch-high handcrafted straight sides, the pan helps achieve the precise edges necessary for a flawless wedding cake. Hand-spun aluminum construction ensures even heat distribution and a light golden brown surface ideal for icing and decorating. The pure aluminum siding does require greasing and flouring before baking to ensure easy cake release. The thick, high-quality design is both durable and reliable; Wilton has such faith in these pans that the company provides a lifetime warranty.

Instructions and baking tips on the packaging detail how much batter and icing to use for various cake sizes, as well as how long to bake layers of varying heights. The 3-inch-high pan sides accommodate up to a 2-3/4-inch-high layer cake when baked; ordinary bakeware can't provide the depth or superior performance this pan does.
